Name: Joah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Joah, son of Asaph, was Hezekiah's recorder and stood with Eliakim and Shebna before the Rabshakeh, then reported to the king with torn clothes.
KeyStory: Joah hears the Rabshakeh and reports to Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Eliakim, Son of Hilkiah; Shebna, Scribe; Asaph, Father of Joah
LifeLesson: The recorder's duty is to hear truly and report honestly, even threats.
